customMethods.name: clearData
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("clearData() called")
	
	self.view.custom.part.data = []
	self.view.custom.part.row = None
	self.view.custom.part.col = None

	return

customMethods.name: openInventoryPolicyEditor
customMethods.script:
partId = self.view.params.value.partId
	selection = self.view.custom.part.selectedData[0] if len(self.view.custom.part.selectedData) > 0 else {}
	partInventoryPolicyId = selection.get('partInventoryPolicyId')
	inventoryAssetId = selection.get('inventoryAssetId')
	system.perspective.openPopup("Part Policy Editor", "kanoa/inventory/parts/partsInventoryPolicyEditor", params={'values': {'partInventoryPolicyId': partInventoryPolicyId, 'partId': partId, 'inventoryAssetId': inventoryAssetId}}, overlayDismiss=True, title='Part Policy Editor', draggable=True, showCloseOption=True, resizable=True, viewPortBound=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: openPartsInventoryEditor
customMethods.script:
partId = self.view.params.value.partId
	selection = self.view.custom.part.selectedData[0] if len(self.view.custom.part.selectedData) > 0 else {}
	inventoryAssetId = selection.get('inventoryAssetId')
	
	system.perspective.openPopup("Part Inventory Editor", "kanoa/inventory/parts/partsTransactionEditor", params={'values': {'partId':partId, 'inventoryAssetId': inventoryAssetId}}, overlayDismiss=True, title='Part Inventory Editor', draggable=True, showCloseOption=True, resizable=True, viewPortBound=True)
